Booking Settings

When enabled, bookings made by students with an instructor will require the instructor to confirm before the booking is finalised. When disabled, bookings are automatically confirmed.

Enabled Disabled

On the bookings calendar, only list instructors who are working on the day being viewed: their regular hours or an ad-hoc availability date, or an existing booking that day. Instructors on holiday or with the day off are hidden. Anyone can switch to "show all instructors" for themselves on the calendar, and an instructor always sees their own row. This is separate from the clubhouse TV's "Show all instructors" setting (Manage Club → Schedule Display).

Enabled Disabled

On the new Find a slot page members see the club's free slots as a grid (a row per day, a column per slot) or as a list of free slots by day. When enabled, the list view is hidden and everyone sees the grid, on a phone too.

Enabled Disabled

A fuel or oil reimbursement is credited when its flight is booked in, and stays so until an admin approves or declines it. A claim above this amount ({{ vm.club.settings.account_currency }}) is e-mailed to the club's admins at once and goes to the top of the receipts to approve. So does a flight whose claims come to more than the flight's own charge, whatever the amount. Set 0 for no amount.

When off, only instructors and admins can start a payment on the club's card machine. Members still pay by direct debit or card.

The replay of a flight's track (route, height and speed). Photos, notes and debriefs stay with the crew and instructors either way. Before a flight is booked in, members can always see where the aircraft is.

When an aircraft slot is already booked, a second booking goes on that aircraft's waiting list (a "double booking"). Choose who may add one — by creating a booking there or by dragging one onto a taken slot. Moving a waiting booking back onto a free slot is always allowed.

When someone asks for a lesson with a voucher (a trial or gift flight), choose who confirms it. A request with no instructor always goes to the club, and club admins can step in on any request. Changing this also moves the requests already waiting.

Lets club staff correct the times a tracker recorded before a pilot claims the flight, for example when the tracker started late. Every change needs a reason and is kept with the flight; the tracker's own times are kept too and can be put back until the flight is claimed. For clubs that charge take-off to landing, staff enter those two times and 5 minutes are added either side.

The fee the club may charge when a booking is cancelled for one of these reasons. Nothing is charged automatically: an instructor or admin decides each time, when they cancel the booking or later from Cancellations on the scheduler. A charge is invoiced to the pilot, collected with their next direct debit if they have a mandate, otherwise left on their account to pay. Leave an amount empty for no fee.

Control who can see booking names on the scheduler. Members can always see their own bookings, and instructors can always see bookings where they are the assigned instructor.

Flight Times Display

Choose how flight times are shown everywhere for this club — the flights list, aircraft journey logs, claim a flight, debriefs and training records all follow it. This is display only: how each aircraft is charged is set on the aircraft itself.

Training records always use brakes off → brakes on and only follow your rounding choice. An individual aircraft can override this on its own settings page, and anyone viewing a page can temporarily switch to another format with the Times control — their choice never changes yours. Hovering any time shows every recorded time to the second.

Membership Renewals

Members whose membership renews automatically are e-mailed this many days before the payment is taken (renewal payments are taken 7 days before the membership ends): the amount, the date, the Direct Debit or card that will be used, and how to change it or switch automatic renewal off. Members whose renewal cannot be taken automatically (no Direct Debit, no saved card…) are told to renew by hand instead. Between 3 and 60 days. Nobody is charged before this e-mail is that many days old, and a membership is never renewed automatically once it has ended.

Automatic renewals are paused for your club by ToAviate: nobody is charged automatically, and members whose membership would renew are e-mailed that it will not renew automatically — renew them by hand, or contact ToAviate to resume.
